stem.text: The diagram shows the reaction pathway for a reversible reaction.

stem.alt: Reaction pathway (energy profile) for a reversible reaction: energy in kJ mol-1 against extent of reaction; products lie 30 kJ mol-1 below reactants, and the peak lies 90 kJ mol-1 above the products

items: The enthalpy change for the forward reaction is $-30\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
The enthalpy change for the backward reaction is $+90\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
